[EN] The leaders of the Tower Guard are Durzured and Vardas, located on Secundus. They're high-value targets—the top of the guards' chain of command.

Take them down.
[ES] Los líderes de la Tower Guard son Durzured y Vardas, ubicados en Secundus. Son objetivos de alto valor, lo más alto de la cadena de mando de la guardia.

Acabad con ellos.

[EN] Nice work, . With their guards in disarray, the tower's vulnerable to our saboteurs.

I can't wait to see that poisonous eyesore shut down.
[ES] Buen trabajo, . Con sus guardias desorganizados, la torre es vulnerable ante nuestros saboteadores.

No veo la hora de ver ese feo y venenoso lugar clausurado.
